user.title: Casio ABL-100WE
user.description: Select a discovered watch or enter its exact Bluetooth address. Discovered: {discovered}

reconfigure.title: Change watch Bluetooth address
reconfigure.description: Only continue if this is the same physical watch with a new Bluetooth address. Select it explicitly or type its exact address; a typed address takes precedence. Existing device and entity identities are preserved. Automatic step reading must be off and remains off; enable it separately only when ready. This form does not connect to the watch or verify ownership. Discovered: {discovered}

error.invalid_address: Enter a valid Bluetooth MAC address
error.invalid_selection: This watch is no longer in discovery. Select it again or enter its exact Bluetooth address.

abort.already_configured: This Bluetooth address belongs to another configured watch or its retained identity.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Bluetooth address updated. Existing entities and device are unchanged.
abort.auto_read_enabled: Turn off automatic step reading in Configure before changing the Bluetooth address. No configuration was changed.
abort.missing_identity: This entry has no stable identity. Its Bluetooth address cannot be changed safely without a separately reviewed repair.

closed.message: The watch entry is no longer active

unavailable.message: Watch unavailable or model unverified; enable watch Bluetooth and a connectable proxy

stale_date.message: Watch record is not dated today; no steps were updated

read_failed.message: Unable to read a complete watch record

alarm_read_failed.message: Unable to read a complete alarm snapshot

zone_read_failed.message: Unable to read complete time zone configuration

init.title: Casio ABL-100WE
init.description: Optional experimental trigger: try reading steps during a Bluetooth advertising window. This does not recognize CNCT mode, maintain a permanent connection, or write the watch time.

data.auto_read_steps: Read steps when watch becomes available
